دورة المرور

A standard rectangular traffic pattern around the airfield used for sequencing aircraft for landing or training operations.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is دورة المرور?

In this glossary, دورة المرور refers to: A standard rectangular traffic pattern around the airfield used for sequencing aircraft for landing or training operations.

How is دورة المرور used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "البرج: G-BZAX، قم بعمل دورة مرور يسارية للمدرج 26، أبلغ عند الرجل الموازية."

Why does دورة المرور matter in aviation?

دورة المرور matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses دورة المرور?

دورة المرور is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Where does this definition come from?

Definition

A standard rectangular traffic pattern around the airfield used for sequencing aircraft for landing or training operations.

Operational example

Tower: G-BZAX, make left-hand circuit runway 26, report downwind.

Localized term

دورة المرور

Localized example

البرج: G-BZAX، قم بعمل دورة مرور يسارية للمدرج 26، أبلغ عند الرجل الموازية.
